title: User registration with valid data
description: Verify that a user can successfully register with valid email, password, and required profile information.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page /auth
Input valid email, username, and password
Complete required profile details
Submit the registration form
Check that registration succeeds and user is redirected to optional MFA or home screen

title: Registration rejected for missing required fields
description: Verify registration form validation rejects submission when required fields are empty or invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page /auth
Leave required fields empty or input invalid email format
Attempt to submit the registration form
Check that validation error messages are displayed, registration is blocked

title: Login success with correct credentials
description: Verify user can login successfully with valid registered email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page /auth
Input valid registered email and password
Click login button
Verify login succeeds and user is taken to the Discover page or dashboard

title: Login failure with incorrect credentials
description: Verify login fails with invalid email or password and appropriate error messages are shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page /auth
Input invalid email or incorrect password
Click login button
Verify error message is displayed and login is denied

title: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) optional flow
description: Verify MFA step triggers optionally after login and requires valid code for access.

steps.description: Login with user account configured to require MFA
Verify MFA input screen is presented
Enter valid MFA code
Verify access is granted post MFA verification
Repeat with invalid MFA code
Verify MFA verification fails and user remains blocked

title: Demo mode access without credentials
description: Verify that users can enter demo mode and explore the platform without real credentials or login.

steps.description: Navigate to /demo page
Enter demo mode
Verify demo UI loads with demo profiles and app factory available
Navigate through core features in demo mode
Verify product tours are accessible and functional without login

title: Discover flow allows liking and generates matches
description: Verify users can browse profiles in /discover, like profiles, and matches appear under /matches for mutual likes.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /discover
View multiple profiles and perform like actions
Verify UI confirms likes registered
Simulate match by mutual like
Navigate to /matches
Verify the match appears in matches list enabling chat access

title: Matches UI correctly reflects no matches scenario
description: Verify the matches page displays appropriate empty state when user has no matches.

steps.description: Login as a new user with no matches
Navigate to /matches
Verify a friendly message or placeholder is shown indicating no matches

title: Access to chat only allowed after match established
description: Verify that users can only open chat sessions with profiles they have matched with.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /chat without matches
Verify chat access is denied or empty
Open chat with matched user
Verify chat UI loads and messaging is enabled

title: Real-time chat message sending and receiving
description: Verify users can send and receive real-time chat messages within matched chat sessions.

steps.description: Open chat with matched user
Send text message
Verify message appears instantly in chat window and on recipient's side
Check notifications or presence indicator updates if applicable

title: Private gallery lock and unlock via token payment
description: Validate private gallery images appear blurred or locked by default and unlock properly after CMPX token payment.

steps.description: Join chat with matched profile containing private gallery
Verify private gallery images are blurred or inaccessible initially
Trigger token payment to unlock gallery content
Verify gallery images become fully visible post payment
Attempt unlock with insufficient token balance
Verify unlock is rejected and error message is shown

title: Tokens dashboard displays balances and transactions
description: Verify that token UI correctly renders user's CMPX and GTK balances and transaction history.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /tokens dashboard
Check displayed CMPX and GTK token balances match backend data
Verify recent token transaction history is listed and formatted
Navigate through token system sub-navigation
Verify navigation works and content updates accordingly

title: Responsive navigation adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop
description: Verify top and bottom navigation components render appropriately and remain usable across different device viewports.

steps.description: Access the app on mobile viewport size
Verify bottom navigation is visible and functional
Resize viewport to tablet size
Verify top navigation appears correctly with accessible menus
Resize viewport to desktop size
Verify full navigation menu and page layouts render without obstruction
Test navigation clicks to different key pages
Verify navigation routes load content without errors

title: Profile creation and editing for single profiles
description: Validate that users can create, view, and edit single profiles with full detail fields and save changes successfully.

steps.description: Login and navigate to profile single creation page /profile-single
Input required profile details and save
Verify profile is saved and displayed correctly in profile detail view
Edit profile with valid changes and save
Verify updates persist and UI reflects new data

title: Profile creation and editing for couple profiles
description: Validate that users can create, view, and edit couple profiles with appropriate layout and data fields.

steps.description: Navigate to couple profile page /profile-couple
Input couple profile data and save
Verify couple profile displays correctly with both users' details
Edit couple profile and save changes
Verify changes appear correctly in the profile layout

title: Events and Clubs rendering verified listings
description: Verify that the Events (/events) and Clubs (/clubs) pages display verified listings and upcoming club info correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Verify event listings load with verified badge and accurate details
Navigate to /clubs
Verify clubs listings render with upcoming club details
Test navigation to club details or join links
Verify no errors occur and UI is responsive

title: Role-based access control for Admin and Moderator UIs
description: Verify that admin and moderation interfaces are protected and accessible only by users with proper roles.

steps.description: Login as non-admin user and attempt to access /admin
Verify access is denied or redirected
Login as admin user and access /admin dashboard
Verify admin UI loads correctly with management functions
Login as non-moderator and try to access /moderators
Verify restricted access enforced
Login as moderator and verify full access to moderation pages

title: AI Help and AI Control Center accessibility
description: Verify AI Help features are accessible from the AI Control Center and provide relevant assistance.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /ai-help
Verify AI Control Center UI loads without errors
Invoke various AI help functions or queries
Verify appropriate responses and assistance are displayed

title: Marketplace, Shop, and NFTs pages load and render correctly
description: Verify that the marketplace (/marketplace), shop (/shop), and NFTs (/nfts) pages load without UI crashes, even with incomplete data.

steps.description: Navigate to /marketplace
Verify marketplace items display or placeholder messages appear if empty
Navigate to /shop and /nfts respectively
Verify UI renders without errors in all token-based commerce pages

title: Legal and information pages render with compliance content
description: Verify that legal pages like Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Ley Olimpia, and Support load and display correct information.

steps.description: Navigate to /terms, /privacy, /ley-olimpia, /support
Verify pages load with expected legal and compliance text
Verify links and contact info are clickable and functional if applicable

title: Navigation components do not obstruct UI on all devices
description: Check that navigation bars and menus do not block important UI elements or cause layout issues on any device.

steps.description: Test the app on mobile, tablet, desktop viewports
Verify navigation components do not overlap forms or content
Interact with navigation toggles, menus, and dropdowns
Verify smooth transitions and no visual glitches occur
